description: Copy a value, and say so. The clipboard call, the two-second confirmation and the failure case in one place, because five apps had written all three. Copy: the label says what will be copied, not that copying happens — "Copy the invoice number". The confirmation is past tense and short.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without one the control is icon-only, in a Tooltip.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: What the label becomes for two seconds after a successful copy. Defaults to the translated "Copied".

props.name: size
props.description: Follows what it sits beside: `sm` inline next to the value, `md` when the copy is its own control.

props.name: variant
props.description: The surface it stands on. `ghost` disappears into a code block or a row until wanted; `secondary` is for a copy the screen is actually offering, where no edge reads as absent.
